svg.title: What happens to a tool call awaiting approval
svg.desc: A worker records a question before the tool runs. An approval or denial queues the job. The next worker runs an approved call once or records a denied result. A job still waiting at its deadline fails.

g.text: Worker asks before running the tool
The API queues the job. On claim, a worker
records the intent and runs the call once.
The API queues the job. On claim, a worker
records a denied result and skips the call.
The job fails. The tool never starts.
